# CallAI — live SEO data for AI agents
中文说明
CallAI gives your AI agent real search data instead of guesses: live Google and Bing results (includ
ing the Google AI Overview and the sites it cites), keyword volume and difficulty, long-tail ideas,
competitor keyword gaps, domain traffic, backlinks and on-page audits.
It works two ways:
- **DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin** — this npm package, `@callaiapi/seo`. Installs the tools plus a
`callai-seo` skill that teaches the agent how to do keyword research, competitor analysis, GEO check

s and audits.
- **Remote MCP server** — `https://api.callaiapi.com/mcp`, for Claude Code, Cursor, VS
Code, Cline, Windsurf and any other MCP client. Nothing to install.
Data comes from DataForSEO. Paid tools bill your CallAI balance per call: top up from $1, no subscri
ption, balance never expires. Every result states what that call cost. Seven free tools need only an
API key. Anyone can list the tools without a key.

## 1. Get an API key

1. Sign up at <https://callaiapi.com/register>.
2. Top up any amount from $1 (cards, Apple Pay / Goo

gle Pay, or USDT on several chains).
3. Create a key under **API Keys**: <https://callaiapi.com/port
al?tab=keys>. It looks like `sk-live-…`. You can set a spend limit per key.
## 2. Install in DeepSeek Harness
Requires dsh 0.2.0 or later.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Use your own profile name instead of `web` if you run another one (`ls ~/.dsh/profiles`). You can al
so install **@callaiapi/seo** from a plugin shop such as dsh-plugin-shop. Restart dsh afterwards — a
newly added plugin is not loaded into a running process.
### Give the plugin your key
The plugin looks for the key in this order and uses the first one it finds:
| Where | How |
| Plugin setting `apiKey` | In the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (below), or in the plugin's settings

page if your dsh build shows one |
| dsh credential `CALLAI_API_KEY` | Saved through dsh's credenti
al settings, or in `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` under `refs`, or in `~/.dsh/.env` (profiles with the c

redentials service, such as `web`) |
| Environment variable `CALLAI_API_KEY` | `CALLAI_API_KEY=sk-li
ve-… dsh web` — works in every profile, including `headless` |
Profile patch, in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`:

Saving the credential through dsh reconnects automatically; changes to the patch file, `.env` or the
environment take effect after a dsh restart.
### Check it works
Start a session and ask *"Which mcp__callai tools do you have?"* — the agent should list 20 tools, a
nd *"Audit https://example.com"* should come back with real data and a `billed_usd` line.
### Plugin settings
| Setting | Default | Meaning |
| `apiKey` | empty | Your CallAI key. Empty means: use the `CALLAI_API_KEY` credential or environmen

t variable |
| `url` | `https://api.callaiapi.com/mcp` | MCP endpoint. Change only if you were given

another one |
| `toolCallTimeoutMs` | `120000` | Per-call timeout; deep SERP and backlink calls can
take up to a minute |

## 4. What to ask
You don't call tools yourself — describe the job and the agent picks the tools. Examples:
- *"Find long-tail keywords about standing desks for the UK with difficulty under 30, then check who

ranks for the top three."*
- *"Compare my site example.com with competitor.com: traffic, the keywor

ds they rank for that I don't, and backlink strength."*
- *"Does Google show an AI Overview for 'bes

t crm for startups'? Which sites does it cite, and is mine one of them?"*
- *"Audit https://example.

com/pricing and give me a fix list."*
- *"I'm about to buy the expired domain old-brand.com. Check i

ts backlinks and spam score."*
- *"Get search volume and CPC for these 40 keywords in Germany, Germa

d spam score."*
- *"Get search volume and CPC for these 40 keywords in Germany, German language: …"*
## 5. Tools reference
In dsh the tools appear as `mcp__callai__<name>`; other clients show `<name>`. Every result is JSON
with `billed_usd` (what the call cost) and `result`. Parameters marked * are required. Every tool ex
cept the backlink and audit tools also accepts `location_code` and `language_code` (section 6).
| Tool | Parameters | Returns |
| `google_serp` | `keyword`*, `depth` 10–100 (default 10), `device` desktop/mobile | Ranked results

(title, URL, domain, snippet); the AI Overview text with its cited sources when Google shows one |
|

`bing_serp` | same as `google_serp` | Ranked Bing results |
| `keyword_overview` | `keywords`* (up

to 100) | Per keyword: search volume, CPC, competition, keyword difficulty 0–100, main intent |
| `k
eyword_ideas` | `keyword`*, `limit` 1–200 (default 50), `max_difficulty` 0–100 | Long-tail keywords

containing the seed, by volume, with the same metrics |
| `ranked_keywords` | `target`* domain, `lim
it` 1–200 (default 50) | Keywords the domain ranks for, by estimated traffic: position, ranking URL,

metrics |
| `domain_overview` | `target`* domain | Estimated organic traffic, number of ranking key

words, position distribution, paid search totals |
